events.title: Treaty of Rapallo Signed
events.description: Italy and the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes (later Yugoslavia) signed the Treaty of Rapallo, settling disputed Adriatic borders. The treaty established the Free State of Fiume and awarded Istria and parts of Dalmatia to Italy.
events.significance: It resolved a major post-World War I territorial dispute in the Adriatic, though the arrangement remained a source of tension between Italy and Yugoslavia.

events.title: Joseph Stalin Consolidates Power as Trotsky Is Expelled
events.description: Leon Trotsky was expelled from the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, a decisive step in Joseph Stalin's rise over his rivals following Lenin's death.
events.significance: The expulsion marked the effective end of the Left Opposition and cleared the way for Stalin's absolute control of the Soviet state.

events.title: Tokyo War Crimes Tribunal Delivers Sentences
events.description: The International Military Tribunal for the Far East concluded its sentencing of Japanese wartime leaders, including Hideki Tojo, who was sentenced to death by hanging along with six others.
events.significance: The Tokyo Trials were a landmark in international justice, establishing precedents for prosecuting crimes against peace and war crimes after World War II.

events.title: Voyager 1 Makes Closest Approach to Saturn
events.description: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft passed within about 124,000 kilometers of Saturn, sending back detailed images and data about the planet, its rings, and its moon Titan.
events.significance: The flyby revolutionized understanding of Saturn's ring structure and Titan's thick atmosphere, and sent Voyager 1 on its trajectory out of the solar system.

events.title: Birth of Sun Yat-sen
events.description: Sun Yat-sen, the revolutionary leader who became the first provisional president of the Republic of China, was born in Guangdong province.
events.significance: Sun Yat-sen is regarded as the founding father of modern China, and his Three Principles of the People shaped Chinese political thought throughout the 20th century.
